subject: [hw] X01 -> lead: include/redwood_vcodec.h comment says VENC windows +0x2000, K02 rev 3 says +0x3000
body:
Not a code change request for my package (hwlog only), a frozen-header comment defect found while making log2script accept real offsets. include/redwood_vcodec.h:14-16 currently says:

 *   VENC 0x17020000+0x2000, VENC_C1 0x17820000+0x2000, VDEC_SYS 0x1602f000, ...

K02 rev 3 (kern/VCODEC_HW.md:16-17,33-34; kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc:128-129) verifies 0x3000: vpud mmaps 0x3000 and JPGENC starts at 0x17030000. Proposed text, same line: "VENC 0x17020000+0x3000, VENC_C1 0x17820000+0x3000, ...". Only the comment changes; RWVC_WIN_* indexes and the ioctl ABI are untouched. T02s fake still models 0x2000; I posted the impact to hw-t02. hwlog now accepts up to 0x3000 so a phone log is not silently filtered.
